title: AI and chip sell-off hits Asia hardest
detail: Nasdaq fell 5.5% on 5 Nov and is in correction (~12% off its October peak); the semiconductor index fell ~12%. KOSPI −11.7% on the week with a circuit breaker; Nikkei −9.3%.
implication: Korea and Japan carry the most equity risk from the AI capex cycle. Watch whether the sell-off spreads into credit, already at 17-month-wide spreads.

title: US jobs rebound; December Fed hike now likely
detail: October payrolls +165k vs ~65k expected; unemployment 4.1%. Odds of a 9 Dec hike rose to ~78%. US 10y at 4.88%, VIX 25.6.
implication: Last week's labour-crack risk faded. The risk now is tighter policy into a tech-led equity correction.

title: BoE and RBA hiked into slowing economies
detail: BoE raised Bank Rate to 4% (8–1), its first hike since 2023, with UK consumer confidence at −24. RBA hiked to 4.85% (6–3), an 18-year high, as Australia's composite PMI fell to 48.2.
implication: Rate-sensitive sectors (housing, banks, retail) in both markets carry the most downside.

title: France slides toward recession
detail: Final October composite PMI 46.6 (flash was 48.4; September 51.1), services 46.2. Q3 GDP was −0.1% q/q; industrial output −1.3% y/y.
implication: A second negative quarter would confirm technical recession. OAT spreads and the euro are the pressure points; the ECB backstop caps the tail.

title: Oil drops ~17% on the week
detail: Brent settled ~$98 on 6 Nov and trades ~$97 today, down from $117 on 23 Oct, on hopes of less Iran conflict after the midterms and talk of diplomacy. Tanker attacks were still reported.
countries: JP KR IN CN TR IT SA RU
implication: Relief for importers (India rallied); a squeeze for producers. Hormuz traffic is still the swing factor.

title: Democrats sweep the midterms
detail: Democrats won the House and Senate on 3 Nov; US stocks rose ~1% the next day, led by import-reliant retailers.
implication: Lower odds of new tariffs helps Mexico and Canada most.

title: Brazil composite PMI falls to 44.4
detail: Services PMI 44.5 from 49.2; industrial output −2.5% y/y. Selic held at 13.75%.
implication: Rate cuts come into play; Argentina is tied to Brazil (16% of exports).

title: Euro-area inflation hits 4.0%
detail: October CPI 4.0% from 3.8%; Italy 5.4%. Euro-area retail sales slowed to +0.4% y/y.
implication: ECB hike bias persists while growth slows: a stagflation squeeze on the periphery.

title: Canada labour market softening
detail: Unemployment rose to 6.7% in Oct from 6.5%; factory PMI fell to 49.6 after the BoC hike.
implication: Risk that the BoC hike was a mistake; the oil cushion is thinner with Brent falling.

title: China official factory PMI stays below 50
detail: NBS manufacturing PMI 49.3; services PMI slipped to 50.8. Hang Seng still rose 5% on the week.

title: Credit spreads remain wide
detail: Global credit spreads were the widest in 17 months in late October on AI-related debt supply; US high yield ~8.5%.
implication: With the chip sell-off, credit is the next place to watch.

title: India +8.6% in a week
detail: Driven by the oil drop and foreign inflows. One week; the RBI is still hiking.

title: Dow +1,500 points on election day after
detail: A one-day relief rally, reversed by the Thursday tech sell-off.

title: Gold back above $4,100
detail: Up on softer oil; flat on the year.

title: Baltic Dry at a 3-week high
detail: +2.4% on the day; still −6% on the month.
